articles.summary: Three premium rainforest villas represent the first expansion since Pursuit acquired Tabacón in 2025, advancing the company's Vision 2030 growth strategy Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (NYSE: PRSU) today announced plans to develop three premium guest accommodation villas at Tabacón Thermal Resort Spa, representing the first major organic growth investment at Tabacón since acquiring the award-winning Costa Rican resort in July 2025. The expansion reflects Pursuit's Vision 2030 strategy of creating long-term shareholder value through disciplined organic growth investments that enhance market-leading guest experiences, alongside strategic acquisitions in iconic destinations. Located within Tabacón’s existing 570-acre resort property, the villas will help guests experience the resort at a deeper level and connect to Costa Rica's largest network of naturally flowing thermal springs, adjacent to the Arenal Volcano National Park protected rainforest reserve. articles.title: Pursuit Announces First Major Organic Growth Investment at Tabacón Thermal Resort & Spa
